runs.content: Allegion beat Q3 (organic +7.2%, adj EPS +13%) and raised FY26 guidance; it is in a clean uptrend near its 52-week high at ~17.8x forward earnings, with no Burry overlap (RIGL hit T1 today; MCK trimmed for capacity).

Leidos trades at ~11.3x the midpoint of twice-raised FY26 adjusted EPS guidance and 32% below its 52-week high, a cheap defense/government-IT services name with no AI-capex or Burry-short overlap; TGT was trimmed (−5.21%) to hold the book at 35.
